reader.notes: The divisor is the runtime argument count after CobolTable.AllArgs expansion: E3 divides by the ODO object's current value 3, E4 by 6 for T2C(ALL ALL), E5 by 3 for T2C(2 ALL), EE by 13. Same output at --std 2023.

refuter.evidence: Divisor is the run-time occurrence count: meanctx2-001 CC (4 ALL elements) 2.35, CE (two ALL ranges, 2 + 3 = 5 occurrences) 7.2, CF eleven explicit 18-digit arguments K (sum of 20 digits, no wrap); degen-001 G3 one occurrence. The sum is formed exactly (CobolIntrinsics.MeanExact: Total then one Quotient), so no high-order digit is lost; the one 34-digit rounding of the quotient (meanprec2-001 P1 500000000000000000 for 499999999999999999.99...95) is the implementor's representation of a numeric function (cite.py OK §1985:IV.4.3.4 'The implementor specifies the representation of integer and numeric functions'), documented in docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-123.md, same at 2023. cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.24.4 RV2 'the sum of the argument-1 series divided by the number of occurrences referenced by argument-1'.
